native_mechanisms: Nightingales always land first on the unlocked stone carrying the smallest owed letter (repeated global minimum-label selection).
Threads cast from the tower price each road by its thief's toll, one direction at a time (directed, per-edge weighted relaxation out of the current stone).

A locked letter is never rechalked again, and threads reaching nowhere (bramble/tide) are dropped, leaving those stones at unreadable debt forever (finality of settled nodes; unreachable nodes abandoned at infinity).
core_technique: Dijkstra's single-source shortest path on a CSR graph with a density switch: SIMD (AVX2) linear-scan argmin over the tentative-distance array (O(n^2)) for dense graphs, and a 4-ary lazy-deletion binary-style heap (O((n+m) log n)) for sparse graphs.
